{
  "technical_and_design_decisions": [
    "Use a Maven multi-module project structure to separate external libraries, SFTP functionality, RedisRule contracts, processor support, module-registry infrastructure, and command-line functionality.",
    "Target Java 17 or newer and retain compatibility with the applicable Spring Framework and Spring Cloud Stream versions already used by the repository.",
    "Prevent dependency shadowing in the uber-jar by applying an explicit dependency precedence and packaging configuration, with validation that externally supplied libraries cannot override approved bundled versions.",
    "Port the SFTP module by adapting the existing Spring XD implementation to the Spring Cloud Stream module conventions rather than rewriting its core behavior.",
    "Place RedisRule-related interfaces, annotations, validation rules, and reusable test support in a standalone commons-style project with minimal dependencies on core functionality.",
    "Provide processor support through a common processor module foundation and lifecycle/configuration abstractions that can be reused by processor modules from the Spring Cloud Stream modules repository.",
    "Implement offline Aether resolution using the local Maven repository and fail clearly when a required artifact is unavailable locally; remote resolution remains the default when offline mode is disabled.",
    "Implement ModuleRegistry with a thread-safe in-process registry and a clear service interface, using module name as the primary lookup key and module coordinates as the stored value.",
    "Implement module information, listing, registration, and unregistration as commands integrated with the existing command framework, including validation and user-readable error messages.",
    "Use unit tests for isolated components and integration tests for packaging, module resolution, registry commands, SFTP behavior, processor support, and cross-module compatibility."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The existing repositories, build files, test infrastructure, command framework, and relevant Spring XD/Spring Cloud Stream source code are available locally and can be inspected.",
    "The increment is implemented by one software developer, and one workday represents approximately eight productive engineering hours.",
    "The specification does not require new user-interface work beyond existing command-line conventions.",
    "No major upgrade of Spring, Maven, Java, or third-party dependencies is required beyond changes necessary to compile and integrate the increment.",
    "The existing uber-jar packaging mechanism can be configured without replacing the build system or introducing a new packaging tool.",
    "The SFTP module has an identifiable Spring XD implementation whose behavior and tests can be ported with moderate adaptation.",
    "Processor support means providing the common foundation and integration points; porting every processor module from the separate modules repository is out of scope.",
    "The RedisRule project is expected to preserve the existing contract and test behavior while isolating reusable rules and test coverage; no new Redis feature set is required.",
    "Offline mode applies to Aether module artifact resolution and uses the developer or runtime user's local Maven repository; repository population and artifact distribution are out of scope.",
    "ModuleRegistry persistence across process restarts is not explicitly required, so the initial implementation is in-memory unless existing project conventions require another storage mechanism.",
    "Existing coding standards, licensing requirements, CI conventions, and release procedures are followed rather than redesigned.",
    "Effort includes implementation, developer testing, integration testing, code review preparation, build updates, and documentation, but excludes project management and elapsed waiting time."
  ],
  "activities": [
    {
      "activity_id": "A1",
      "activity_name": "Repository and architecture analysis",
      "activity_description": "Inspect the existing s-c-d and s-c-s repositories, build structure, dependency graph, packaging process, command framework, module conventions, Spring XD SFTP implementation, and current test coverage. Produce an implementation-level change plan.",
      "most_likely_effort": 4
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A2",
      "activity_name": "Uber-jar dependency precedence enforcement",
      "activity_description": "Update dependency and packaging configuration so approved bundled libraries cannot be overridden by external libraries in the uber-jar. Add build-time or runtime validation and regression tests for conflicting versions and normal packaging.",
      "most_likely_effort": 5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A3",
      "activity_name": "External library project extraction",
      "activity_description": "Move the external library code into its own project or Maven module, define its public API and dependencies, update consumers and parent build configuration, and verify clean separation and artifact publication.",
      "most_likely_effort": 8
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A4",
      "activity_name": "SFTP module port from Spring XD",
      "activity_description": "Port the Spring XD SFTP source module into the s-c-s repository, adapt configuration and lifecycle integration to current module conventions, migrate or create tests, and verify source-module behavior in a streaming pipeline.",
      "most_likely_effort": 12
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A5",
      "activity_name": "RedisRule standalone project",
      "activity_description": "Create the isolated project or commons module for the RedisRule contract and associated rules, move reusable test coverage, update package and dependency references, and verify that core functionality remains decoupled.",
      "most_likely_effort": 7
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A6",
      "activity_name": "Processor module foundation",
      "activity_description": "Design and implement the common foundation for out-of-the-box processor modules, including module registration/configuration conventions, execution integration, lifecycle handling, and representative tests using processor modules from the modules repository.",
      "most_likely_effort": 15
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A7",
      "activity_name": "Offline Aether module resolution",
      "activity_description": "Add offline-mode configuration and behavior to AetherModuleResolver, resolve artifacts from the local Maven repository, provide deterministic failures for missing artifacts, preserve online behavior, and add resolver unit and integration tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 8
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A8",
      "activity_name": "ModuleRegistry implementation",
      "activity_description": "Define the module coordinate and registry APIs, implement thread-safe registration, lookup, listing, and unregistration behavior, validate duplicate and missing names, and add focused unit and integration tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 10
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A9",
      "activity_name": "Module registry commands",
      "activity_description": "Implement module info, list, register, and unregister commands using the existing command framework. Add argument validation, output formatting, error handling, command help, and command-level tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 10
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A10",
      "activity_name": "Cross-feature integration and regression testing",
      "activity_description": "Run and extend the complete test suite across separated projects, dependency packaging, SFTP source behavior, processor support, offline resolution, registry operations, and command workflows. Diagnose and fix integration and compatibility defects.",
      "most_likely_effort": 14
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A11",
      "activity_name": "Build, CI, documentation, and delivery preparation",
      "activity_description": "Update parent builds, dependency management, CI jobs, examples, configuration documentation, migration notes, and release artifacts. Perform final clean builds and prepare the increment for review and delivery.",
      "most_likely_effort": 6
    }
  ],
  "reported_total": {
    "most_likely_effort": 99
  }
}

technical_and_design_decisions: Use a Maven multi-module project structure to separate external libraries, SFTP functionality, RedisRule contracts, processor support, module-registry infrastructure, and command-line functionality.
Target Java 17 or newer and retain compatibility with the applicable Spring Framework and Spring Cloud Stream versions already used by the repository.

Prevent dependency shadowing in the uber-jar by applying an explicit dependency precedence and packaging configuration, with validation that externally supplied libraries cannot override approved bundled versions.
Port the SFTP module by adapting the existing Spring XD implementation to the Spring Cloud Stream module conventions rather than rewriting its core behavior.
Place RedisRule-related interfaces, annotations, validation rules, and reusable test support in a standalone commons-style project with minimal dependencies on core functionality.

Provide processor support through a common processor module foundation and lifecycle/configuration abstractions that can be reused by processor modules from the Spring Cloud Stream modules repository.

Implement offline Aether resolution using the local Maven repository and fail clearly when a required artifact is unavailable locally; remote resolution remains the default when offline mode is disabled.
Implement ModuleRegistry with a thread-safe in-process registry and a clear service interface, using module name as the primary lookup key and module coordinates as the stored value.
Implement module information, listing, registration, and unregistration as commands integrated with the existing command framework, including validation and user-readable error messages.
Use unit tests for isolated components and integration tests for packaging, module resolution, registry commands, SFTP behavior, processor support, and cross-module compatibility.
assumptions: The existing repositories, build files, test infrastructure, command framework, and relevant Spring XD/Spring Cloud Stream source code are available locally and can be inspected.
The increment is implemented by one software developer, and one workday represents approximately eight productive engineering hours.
The specification does not require new user-interface work beyond existing command-line conventions.
No major upgrade of Spring, Maven, Java, or third-party dependencies is required beyond changes necessary to compile and integrate the increment.
The existing uber-jar packaging mechanism can be configured without replacing the build system or introducing a new packaging tool.
The SFTP module has an identifiable Spring XD implementation whose behavior and tests can be ported with moderate adaptation.
Processor support means providing the common foundation and integration points; porting every processor module from the separate modules repository is out of scope.
The RedisRule project is expected to preserve the existing contract and test behavior while isolating reusable rules and test coverage; no new Redis feature set is required.
Offline mode applies to Aether module artifact resolution and uses the developer or runtime user's local Maven repository; repository population and artifact distribution are out of scope.
ModuleRegistry persistence across process restarts is not explicitly required, so the initial implementation is in-memory unless existing project conventions require another storage mechanism.
Existing coding standards, licensing requirements, CI conventions, and release procedures are followed rather than redesigned.
Effort includes implementation, developer testing, integration testing, code review preparation, build updates, and documentation, but excludes project management and elapsed waiting time.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the existing s-c-d and s-c-s repositories, build structure, dependency graph, packaging process, command framework, module conventions, Spring XD SFTP implementation, and current test coverage. Produce an implementation-level change plan.

Update dependency and packaging configuration so approved bundled libraries cannot be overridden by external libraries in the uber-jar. Add build-time or runtime validation and regression tests for conflicting versions and normal packaging.

Move the external library code into its own project or Maven module, define its public API and dependencies, update consumers and parent build configuration, and verify clean separation and artifact publication.

activities.activity_name: SFTP module port from Spring XD
activities.activity_description: Port the Spring XD SFTP source module into the s-c-s repository, adapt configuration and lifecycle integration to current module conventions, migrate or create tests, and verify source-module behavior in a streaming pipeline.

Create the isolated project or commons module for the RedisRule contract and associated rules, move reusable test coverage, update package and dependency references, and verify that core functionality remains decoupled.

Design and implement the common foundation for out-of-the-box processor modules, including module registration/configuration conventions, execution integration, lifecycle handling, and representative tests using processor modules from the modules repository.

Add offline-mode configuration and behavior to AetherModuleResolver, resolve artifacts from the local Maven repository, provide deterministic failures for missing artifacts, preserve online behavior, and add resolver unit and integration tests.

Define the module coordinate and registry APIs, implement thread-safe registration, lookup, listing, and unregistration behavior, validate duplicate and missing names, and add focused unit and integration tests.
Implement module info, list, register, and unregister commands using the existing command framework. Add argument validation, output formatting, error handling, command help, and command-level tests.

Run and extend the complete test suite across separated projects, dependency packaging, SFTP source behavior, processor support, offline resolution, registry operations, and command workflows. Diagnose and fix integration and compatibility defects.
